column3: Close to the Hebrew; “From the kisses” is rendered “with the kisses,” and the plural “loves” as “love.” NASB marks the speakers with quotation marks.
“Your oils are good for odor” is rendered “Your oils have a pleasing fragrance,” “oil poured out [is] your name” as “Your name is like purified oil,” and “young women” as “maidens.”
NASB adds “together” and divides the verse between speakers; “let us bring to remembrance” is rendered “We will extol,” and “uprightly they love you” as “Rightly do they love you.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Black and lovely” is rendered “black but lovely.”
“Who I am blackish” is rendered “because I am swarthy,” and “the sun has looked on me” as “the sun has burned me.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “your flock” and “it,” and “a veiled woman” is rendered “one who veils herself.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Dwelling places” is rendered “tents,” and “footprints” as “trail.”
Close to the Hebrew; “To my mare … I liken you” is rendered “To me … you are like My mare,” and “friend” as “darling.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Strings of jewels” is rendered “ornaments.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Necklaces” is rendered “ornaments.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Until” is rendered “While,” and “my nard” as “My perfume.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Bag” is rendered “pouch,” and “it lodges” as “lies all night.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Here you are beautiful” is rendered “How beautiful you are,” and NASB adds “like” (“like doves”).
Close to the Hebrew; “Beautiful” is rendered “handsome,” and “bed” as “couch.”
